facts.statement: The Reserve Bank of India reduced the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) from 4.5 per cent to 4.0 per cent in two tranches of 25 basis points each.
facts.subject: Cash Reserve Ratio
facts.evidence_quote: CRR was 14, reduced 2024 and from December 4.5 per 28, cent 2024. to 4.0 per cent in two tranches of 25 basis points (bps) each

facts.statement: The Reserve Bank's balance sheet size was 22.8 per cent of GDP as at end-March 2025.
facts.subject: Reserve Bank's balance sheet size
facts.evidence_quote: The Reserve Bank’s balance sheet size moderated to 22.8 per cent of GDP as at end-March 2025

facts.statement: The Reserve Bank's balance sheet size was 23.5 per cent of GDP as at end-March 2024.
facts.subject: Reserve Bank's balance sheet size
facts.evidence_quote: from 23.5 per cent as at end-March 2024

facts.statement: Reserve money growth, adjusted for the first-round impact of change in CRR, was 5.8 per cent in 2024-25.
facts.subject: Reserve money growth
facts.predicate: adjusted for the first-round impact of change in CRR
facts.evidence_quote: The RM17 growth, adjusted for the first-round impact of change in CRR, stood at 5.8 per cent in 2024-25

facts.statement: Reserve money growth, adjusted for the first-round impact of change in CRR, was 6.7 per cent in 2023-24.
facts.subject: Reserve money growth
facts.predicate: adjusted for the first-round impact of change in CRR
facts.evidence_quote: as compared with 6.7 per cent a year ago

facts.statement: Currency in circulation growth was 5.8 per cent during 2024-25.
facts.subject: Currency in circulation growth

facts.statement: Currency in circulation growth was 4.1 per cent during 2023-24.
facts.subject: Currency in circulation growth
facts.evidence_quote: from 4.1 per cent a year ago

facts.statement: Bankers' deposits with the Reserve Bank declined by 6.5 per cent during 2024-25.
facts.subject: Bankers' deposits with the Reserve Bank
facts.evidence_quote: declined by 6.5 per cent during the year

facts.statement: Bankers' deposits with the Reserve Bank rose by 4.4 per cent during 2024-25, adjusted for the first-round impact of the CRR reduction.
facts.subject: Bankers' deposits with the Reserve Bank
facts.predicate: growth adjusted for the first-round impact of the CRR reduction
facts.evidence_quote: Adjusted for the first-round impact of the CRR reduction, bankers’ deposits rose by 4.4 per cent.

facts.statement: Net foreign assets of the Reserve Bank expanded by ₹2.8 lakh crore during 2024-25.
facts.subject: Net foreign assets of the Reserve Bank
facts.evidence_quote: During 2024-25, NFA expanded by ₹2.8 lakh crore

facts.statement: Net sales of foreign currency assets to authorised dealers were ₹2.9 lakh crore during 2024-25.
facts.subject: Net sales of foreign currency assets to authorised dealers
facts.evidence_quote: net sales to authorised dealers at ₹2.9 lakh crore

facts.statement: Net purchases of foreign currency assets were ₹3.4 lakh crore during 2023-24.
facts.subject: Net purchases of foreign currency assets
facts.evidence_quote: as against net purchases of ₹3.4 lakh crore during the previous year.

facts.statement: The share of gold in net foreign assets was 12.0 per cent as at end-March 2025.
facts.subject: Share of gold in net foreign assets
facts.evidence_quote: The share of gold in NFA increased to 12.0 per cent as at end-March 2025

facts.statement: The share of gold in net foreign assets was 8.3 per cent as at end-March 2024.
facts.subject: Share of gold in net foreign assets
facts.evidence_quote: from 8.3 per cent as at end-March 2024
